title: Publications
description: Covers awareness of and access to operational publications like WTT, STN, WON, PON, Sectional Appendix, Rule Book, and handling updates.

knowledgeUnits.concept: How are you kept up-to-date with publication changes?
knowledgeUnits.definition: The PON updates the sectional appendix and Rule Book changes. Briefings from managers, STUD days, Train crew notice case.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Updates are automatically downloaded to the train's systems.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Annual refresher courses cover all changes.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Staying current with rules and procedures involves multiple channels: receiving Periodical Operating Notices (PON), attending briefings and STUD days, and checking the Train Crew Notice Case.

knowledgeUnits.concept: How can you access information regarding the rule book and c2c appendices?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Rule books kept in driver managers' offices. Found on c2c intranet, RSSB website, RC documents app, and rule book app on iPad.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Only physical copies are available at depots.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Access is restricted to managers only.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Copies can be purchased from the RSSB.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: The Rule Book and associated appendices are accessible through various means: physical copies in manager offices, digitally via the company intranet, the official RSSB website, and dedicated apps on the company iPad.

knowledgeUnits.concept: Explain the contents of the WTT and when you would need to refer to it.
knowledgeUnits.definition: Contains train timings (Arr/Dep), performance/engineering/pathing allowances (<>, [], ()), identifies train types (1-Fast, 2-All stops, 3-Freight/Staff, 5-ECS, 9-Special). Check passing times for fast services, check departure/arrival times.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Contains emergency procedures and contact numbers.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Lists station facilities and accessibility information.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Details track speed restrictions and signal locations.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: The Working Timetable (WTT) is critical for operational timings. It details scheduled arrival/departure times, various time allowances, and service types. Drivers refer to it to manage punctuality, especially for non-stopping sections, and to confirm schedule details.

knowledgeUnits.concept: Explain the principle sections of the STN and when you would need to refer to it.
knowledgeUnits.definition: Contains alterations to the WTT (extra trains, revised stops/times), planned events (sports, engineering), line closures, ticket acceptance, additional dispatch requirements.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Contains updates to the Rule Book.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Lists staff roster changes and assignments.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: The Special Traffic Notice (STN) details short-term changes and additions affecting the WTT, such as extra services, altered schedules due to events or engineering works, and related operational instructions.

knowledgeUnits.concept: Explain the principle sections of the WON and when you would need to refer to it.
knowledgeUnits.definition: Contains Safety notices, Section A (TSRs), Section B (Engineering), Section C (Signalling/P-Way alterations), Section D (General instructions/notices, Multi SPAD signals). Check for rule changes, TSRs, signalling changes etc.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Focuses primarily on timetable amendments for the week.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Contains staff news and company announcements.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Details passenger information and disruption advice.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: The Weekly Operating Notice (WON) is a crucial safety document containing Temporary Speed Restrictions (TSRs), engineering works details, signalling and track alterations, general safety instructions, and updates like Multi-SPAD signal lists.

knowledgeUnits.concept: Explain the sections of the PON and when you would need to refer to it.
knowledgeUnits.definition: Part 1: New items (marked with thick black line). Part 2: Items previously in PON, still current (marked with * if last published there). Includes AR2 (Alterations to Rulebook), Alterations to Sectional Appendix.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Only contains information relevant for the next 28 days.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Is a summary of the previous month's WONs.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Details permanent changes to station layouts only.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: The Periodical Operating Notice (PON) compiles longer-term operational changes and updates, including amendments to the Rule Book and Sectional Appendix. Part 1 highlights brand new items, while Part 2 carries over still-current items from previous PONs.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What publication can you find information on line speed?
knowledgeUnits.explanation: The Sectional Appendix is the definitive source for route-specific information, including permissible line speeds for different sections of track.
